population: Every distinct ordinary target expression for which the full frozen model misses a reachable subject and at least one alternative final reference column would rescue it at 0.25 or 0.50.
eligibility: Use the already sealed final choices and scores. This panel never changes training, selected methods, or the primary scoring denominator.
blind_review: Reviewer sees original expression, the reference mention actually read, original RGB and the pre-existing annotated object inventory only. No predictions, rank, target IoU or score changes shown.
criteria: Assign an annotated 3D referent only when its identity can be identified by the original expression and image. Keep non-singular, scene anchors, unannotated instances and uncertain matches unresolved. One local reviewer.
test: If the native reference has a different identifiable physical owner, and restricting the original joint scores to columns belonging to the blind verified referent recovers the threshold, count a verified wrong-reference rescue. Unknown predicted assignment is separate.
